item.description:
### Added - **OpenCode v2 sessions are back on the fleet.** OpenCode 2 keeps every session in one background server, and Perch could not see them. Perch now follows that server directly, so every v2 session shows live on the Mac and the phone: working, idle, or needing you. That covers sessions from the terminal, the Desktop app and the web. When a session needs you, the row shows what it waits on: the command it wants to run, or the titles of the questions it asks. Cost, tokens, the model and plan mode show as they do for OpenCode 1. Answering a v2 prompt from Perch, and jumping to its window, come later; for now, answer in OpenCode. Nothing needs installing or restarting. - **Claude rows show the session's name, and its pull request.** A name set with `/rename` or `--name`, or the title Claude writes for a session, now becomes the row's title, even when it changes mid-session. If the branch has an open pull request, the row says so with its review state, for example "PR #1234 approved" or "PR #12 changes requested". The badge goes away when the pull request is merged or closed. Both come from the status line Perch sets up for Claude Code.
### Fixed - **A Claude session running without Perch's hooks shows working while it works.** Such a session, for example one started with `--bare`, read idle for its whole turn. It now shows working, with the time since the turn began. Stopping it with Esc does not send a "finished" alert. - **Perch's OpenCode plugin loads in OpenCode 2.** OpenCode 2 reported it as a plugin that failed to load. It now loads cleanly in both versions. - **No frozen OpenCode session after upgrading to OpenCode 2.** OpenCode 2 stops writing the sessions OpenCode 1 kept, and Perch went on showing the last of those as if it were current.
### Changed - **Perch does less work while you're not looking at it.** The fleet window and Settings stop drawing while they are closed, hidden, minimised or on another desktop. Rows redraw only when something they show changes, and their spinners and timers animate without waking Perch every second. - **The working spinner on a row is a turning arc** instead of the system's spoked spinner. Past an hour, a row's timer reads `1:02:05` instead of `62:05`. With Reduce Motion on, rows hold still.
